changelog:
* Job vehicles (rental trucks, forklifts, carrier cargo cars) now get keys through nc-vehiclekeys - installs running the new nc-vehiclekeys no longer leave drivers locked out
* Temporary keys are removed automatically when the job vehicle is deleted, the player leaves, or the script stops
* Car carrier: customer car keys are handed over when you sign the manifest at the dispatcher
* Car carrier: single-car flatbed jobs now require driving the garage flatbed - the mission no longer spawns one, and after delivery you check out at the dispatcher to get your receipt and payout
* Fixed: deliveries could not be paid out without actually delivering the vehicles
* Fixed: a player connecting near a job site could delete other players' job vehicles and props (including the flatbed bed)
* Fixed moto delivery: the handover could get stuck and the mail envelope was invisible in your hand
* Much lower CPU usage - idle and during delivery jobs
* Removed the route panel (K key) - job progress now lives in the on-screen task HUD and F7 dashboard
